row.body: The gallery key is wrapped in a request to protect the collection; the handover form says the building was secure before the key was returned.
row.title: The gallery key

cites.quote: Whoever finds this, I was Natalie Sigmundsson

sidecar.gloss: A secure-building handover is recorded before the key returns.
sidecar.rival_reading: A preservation team could have secured the room against any hazard; the form does not show who checked it.
